verdict.rationale: Testing in isolation from production is a fair question for an agent engineering-skills bundle, since such a pack could ship a skill or guardrail for sandboxed testing. The evidence shows only TDD guidance (red-green-refactor, pre-agreed seams) and throwaway prototyping. Nothing describes a sandbox environment, isolated test data, or protection of production data, and TDD practice is an adjacent feature, not sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
